title: Full-stack template: how the code works
subtitle: FastAPI back end and React front end (fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template)
description: Module notes for the public full-stack FastAPI template. Build with: python scripts/analyze_modules.py <template repo> --select api && python scripts/build_flowmap.py examples/sample-module-notes.json --modules <template repo>/.codeflow/modules.json --out template-map.html

assumptions: Emails are sent only when SMTP settings are configured.
open_questions: Is there a retention period for deactivated users?

modules.label: Web API
modules.description: Receives every request from the website, checks who is asking, and hands the work to the data layer.
modules.why: Every user action passes through here, so a fault here is visible to everyone.
risks: Deleting a user also deletes all their items; there is no undo (backend/app/api/routes/users.py:228).

modules.label: Data and email
modules.description: Defines the users and items tables, the only code that writes them, and the emails the system sends.

functions.description: Lets an administrator change another user's details, refusing an email address that someone else already uses.
Checks a sign-in: finds the user by email and compares the password with the stored scrambled (hashed) version.

views.title: User account states
views.summary: The states a user account moves through. New accounts are active straight away (is_active defaults to true).

states.label: Active
states.description: Created through the sign-up page or by an administrator; can sign in and manage items.

states.label: Deactivated
states.description: is_active is false: sign-in is refused.
